I want to know about battles to come.
I want to know where my relationships will lead.
I want to know what will happen to me as [Root.GetTitle].

Marvelous! This predicts a glorious future!
Damnation! This predicts a looming disaster!
The battle is fierce and I have gained new skills! The future I divined in the past certainly was accurate! My personal guard are being left behind as I charge into battle. I am amazing!

The battle rages on and I am surprised by every arrow that I deflect and by every blow that misses me. I have been waiting for something terrible to happen, yet [Root.TrueReligion.GetHighGodName] does not seem finished with me. I suppose there is a chance that I have misinterpreted the outcome of my earlier divination.
The Heavens watch over us!
We will not be overcome!
With me!

As the battle rages on, I am not surprised by the heavy losses we are taking. Every arrow that sears over my head makes my pulse quicken. Just as I am becoming convinced that this is the battle I divined would not go in my favour, I stumble from a sharp pain in my leg. An arrows sticks out from my knee.

We have been fighting this war for what feels like an eternity and I fail to see how anything good can come of all this bloodshed. Just as I am beginning to think that I misinterpreted the future I divined, I am hit by something, hard. An arrow sticks out from my knee.
At least I was right.
Curses! Where is the glory in this?

I meet the stare of my newborn [From.GetSonDaughter] for the first time and it is clear that I divined the future correctly! Rarely have I seen such clear signs of intelligence and ambition in one so young. [From.GetFirstName] is the child that was promised!
I am not sure what I was expecting, but this child blinks at me with the most curious eyes. I suddenly feel all my worries wash away. I must have misinterpreted the outcome of my divination.
I knew it!
I will be the first to admit I was wrong.

My worst fears have come true. Behind the dull stare of my newborn baby [From.GetSonDaughter] there can be little in the way of brilliance or even ability. In time I will know for sure but I am already convinced that this is the bad future I divined.

I am not sure what I was expecting, but this newborn child blinks at me with the dullest of eyes. I feel my confidence wane as I hold [From.GetHerHim] and I soon give [From.GetHerHim] back to the nurse. I must have misinterpreted the outcome of my divination.
There is scarce consolation in this accomplishment.
Even a [Root.GetTitle] can be wrong.

[Root.TrueReligion.GetHighGodName] must have sent us this creature, as it took ten men to bring the beast down, and the effect it has had on my soldiers is clearly the boon I have been waiting for. I am told a peculiar tale of an owl, which has taken up residence under the roofing of one of our barracks. The guards have tried chasing it off, but it keeps returning. "Perhaps it is meant for me?" I offer to one of my advisors, who responds: "My distinguished [Root.GetLordLady], it would make for a very distinguished pet..."

I am told of an owl having taken up residence under the roofing of our barracks. One of my advisors suggest I make it a pet. But should not my divinations have revealed something specific about it, if this creature is what it was about? 'Do not dwell on this, [Root.GetMasterMistress]', my steward says, handing me the caged bird.
I knew it!
How unexpected!
An owl will surely grant me wisdom!
How did I not predict this?
My divination has hinted at this, all along, I think.
I clearly did not interpret my divination correctly, but I don't even mind!

I am suddenly reminded of the terrible future I divined, and I yank the reins of my horse tight in retreat. "Protect the [Root.GetTitle]!" I hear, just before the sound of a flying arrow is cut short. I groan.
